item.case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
item.title: Meet the Real F-35A

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II. Show it taking off from a runway, then flying. Label it 'F-35A Lightning II', with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Calm English narration explaining those two facts. Real aircraft proportions, not a sci-fi jet.

item.tests: Tests whether a short factual aircraft film preserves the named variant's visible geometry and operating characteristics.

answer_sheet.Aircraft and variant: The real F-35A Lightning II, not the F-35B or F-35C.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: F-35A Lightning II; One engine; Conventional takeoff.
answer_sheet.Narration: Calm English narration explaining that the F-35A has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway; exact wording and voice are your call.
answer_sheet.Visual style and setting: Realistic documentary imagery; runway location, weather and camera angles are your call.
answer_sheet.Music: Your call, provided the narration remains clear.

must_haves: The aircraft has the recognizable F-35 configuration: one rear engine exhaust, two outward-canted vertical tails and no canards.
The takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off, not hovering or a vertical launch.
The same aircraft design remains consistent between the runway and airborne views.
All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible.
Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional runway takeoff without attributing F-35B hover capability to the F-35A.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: An 8-second photorealistic aviation mini-documentary introducing the real Lockheed Martin F-35A Lightning II, not science fiction. Widescreen. Accurate real-world aircraft proportions and recognizable F-35A geometry: single engine with ONE rear exhaust nozzle, single-seat canopy, angular stealth fuselage, trapezoidal wings and twin outward-canted vertical stabilizers, realistic matte gray military finish. The conventional runway takeoff F-35A variant, no vertical takeoff, no hovering, no lift fan. First 0–4 seconds: documentary telephoto side tracking view of the aircraft already at takeoff speed on a realistic runway, rotates and lifts off with forward speed, landing gear visible. Then 4–8 seconds: clean cut to a side three-quarter aerial tracking view of the same aircraft flying steadily, gear retracted. Natural daylight, realistic scale and physics, restrained camera work. Clear simple readable documentary typography: title 'F-35A Lightning II' remains at upper left throughout. Supporting label 'One engine' appears alone at lower left from 0–4 seconds, then is replaced by 'Conventional takeoff' from 4–8 seconds. Spell these labels exactly; no other text. Calm English documentary narrator says: 'The F-35A Lightning II has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway.' Natural, measured speech fitting within eight seconds, with subtle aircraft sound beneath it, no music. Prioritize realistic aircraft shape, factual variant accuracy, readable labels and calm narration.
